nodes.label: Two-layer architecture (trigger / driver / executor)
nodes.rationale: Triggering is instantaneous while execution is multi-hour; separating them into layers with different owners lets the fragile long-running, limit-prone part be hardened while the trigger stays deterministic and trivial.

nodes.label: Dispatch tick (eligibility, concurrency cap, pid lock)
nodes.norm_label: dispatch tick (eligibility, concurrency cap, pid lock)

nodes.label: Executor (coding-agent CLI, the only component with a brain)
nodes.norm_label: executor (coding-agent cli, the only component with a brain)

nodes.label: agents.js router (invoke contract, profiles)
nodes.rationale: The runner never calls a CLI directly; it delegates to agents.js so adding a new executor CLI means adding one profile and nothing else changes.

nodes.label: Exit-code contract (0 done / 75 limit / else ambiguous)
nodes.norm_label: exit-code contract (0 done / 75 limit / else ambiguous)

nodes.label: Invariant: no AI in the control loop
nodes.norm_label: invariant: no ai in the control loop

nodes.label: Invariant: add-only design -> conflict-free merges
nodes.rationale: Each side only ever adds new files (author: tasks/prompts/batches; worker: reports on per-task branches). A shared mutable file would be a guaranteed merge conflict, so mutable runtime status lives off-git in gitignored state/.

nodes.label: Invariant: gates are prose, never fields
nodes.norm_label: invariant: gates are prose, never fields

nodes.label: Invariant: resume via CLI session ids
nodes.rationale: On a usage-limit hit the runner parks until the reset time then resumes the SAME CLI session with full context; session ids are persisted the moment they appear and recovered from the newest attempt log if the runner died first.
nodes.norm_label: invariant: resume via cli session ids

nodes.label: Invariant: per-task branches, never main/dev directly
nodes.norm_label: invariant: per-task branches, never main/dev directly

nodes.label: Invariant: machine identity, no cross-machine racing
nodes.rationale: Every machine declares role+id in gitignored state/.machine at init; only role=worker dispatches and a task runs only on its named worker. Because state/ never crosses git this declaration is the only cross-machine coordination — enough because each task has exactly one owner.
nodes.norm_label: invariant: machine identity, no cross-machine racing

nodes.label: Invariant: the author is the only merger
nodes.norm_label: invariant: the author is the only merger

nodes.label: Invariant: liveness by PID, not by silence
nodes.rationale: A task is dead only when its process group is gone; an executor fanning out sub-agents can legitimately emit nothing for 10+ minutes, so never kill on stream silence — cancel kills the recorded process group (SIGTERM then SIGKILL after 5s).
nodes.norm_label: invariant: liveness by pid, not by silence

nodes.label: Process model (detached process groups replace tmux/flock)
nodes.norm_label: process model (detached process groups replace tmux/flock)

nodes.label: TASK_DONE sentinel + trust-but-verify completion
nodes.rationale: Completion requires BOTH the [[TASK_DONE ...]] sentinel AND a new commit — the executor never self-certifies.

nodes.label: 选择目标
nodes.rationale: Cancel target is either a single task or all queued/running tasks at once.

nodes.label: 任务已经收尾了？
nodes.rationale: Decision gate: a task already in a terminal state (completed/failed/cancelled) must not be touched.

nodes.label: 拒绝，不动它
nodes.rationale: Idempotency guard: cancellation of a finished task is a no-op, not an error.

nodes.label: 停掉运行中的任务
nodes.rationale: Stops the task together with its coding assistant process; must work even while the task is waiting on a quota/limit.

nodes.label: 标记「已取消」+ 记录原因
nodes.rationale: After cancelling, the task is marked cancelled with a recorded reason; the watchdog skips it from then on and notification hooks receive the cancel message.
nodes.norm_label: 标记「已取消」+ 记录原因

nodes.label: 有任务依赖它吗？
nodes.rationale: Decision gate: dependency graph traversal to decide whether downstream tasks are affected.

nodes.label: 级联取消依赖者
nodes.rationale: Dependents of a cancelled task cannot do useful work, so they are cancelled too, recording the root cause of the cancellation.

nodes.label: 收尾：代码现场保留
nodes.rationale: The task branch and working state are left untouched so the workspace can be inspected afterwards.

nodes.label: 看门狗（watchdog）
nodes.rationale: Runtime supervisor that picks up tasks; after cancellation it permanently skips the cancelled task.

nodes.label: 通知钩子
nodes.rationale: Hook mechanism that receives a cancel message so external systems are notified of the cancellation.

nodes.label: 编码助手
nodes.rationale: The autonomous coding-agent process attached to a running task; cancelling a task also stops this process, even when it is waiting on a quota.

nodes.label: 取消只在执行机上生效
nodes.rationale: Cancellation only takes effect on the executor machine that owns the task, because it requires live workspace state and the running process.
nodes.norm_label: 取消只在执行机上生效

nodes.label: 确认这台机器的角色
nodes.rationale: 机器分为「作者（发起/验收）」和「执行者（干活）」两种角色，决定后续是否启动看门狗。

nodes.label: 出现「完成标记」？
nodes.rationale: 是 → 认定完成，走出循环；否 → 进入失败处理。

nodes.label: 完成标记
nodes.rationale: 循环退出信号：出现完成标记 且 确实有新提交，双重验证才算数，防止误判完成。

nodes.label: 没完成怎么办？
nodes.rationale: 撞上使用限额 → 停车等重置再回来；其他失败 → 短暂等待后重试（都有限次）。

nodes.label: 双重验证
nodes.rationale: 出现完成标记 且 确实有新提交——双条件才算完成，避免空跑误判。

nodes.label: 写执行报告
nodes.rationale: 结果摘要：完成/失败、重试次数、最后的话。

nodes.label: 推送成果 + 记录最终状态
nodes.rationale: 作者那边一拉就能看到；绝不擅自合并——把合并决策留给作者。
nodes.norm_label: 推送成果 + 记录最终状态
